title: Pay early on undeveloped board
description: Pay early on undeveloped board. Early acquisition tempo matters more than saving $50. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: Paying to get moving. Let’s see who’s actually built for a property war.
final_action.private_thought: Pay fine. Cash is ample, and I want guaranteed movement and tempo rather than gambling on doubles.

breakdown.message: Leaves a playable reserve after paying.
Chooses movement tempo over passive protection.
Private thought names why exiting matters.
